verdict.rationale: Pipecat Cloud's pricing page directly states unlimited concurrency and offers different agent profiles for compute needs. This first-party claim addresses scaling to many simultaneous calls without requesting capacity, but it is a single marketing-page line with no detailed scaling documentation. missing for 10: in-depth docs on concurrency or rate limits and autoscaling behavior, per-agent or per-region capacity details, documented burst/warm-instance handling, independent or hands-on corroboration of scaling to many simultaneous calls.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see documented concurrency limits and scale to many simultaneous calls without manual capacity begging

citations.quote: Pipecat Cloud offers different agent profiles, to best support your use case and compute needs.
